punchline: A model built without the measurements failed within minutes of meeting them.
thirty_sec: In December 1951, Watson and Crick showed the King's College group a three-helix model with the phosphates inside. Rosalind Franklin said at once that DNA's easy uptake and loss of water meant the phosphates belong outside. Bragg then told them to stop work on DNA.
question: Who holds the real numbers behind your current plan, and when will you show them the rough version?
key_contrast: Building first versus checking with the data holder.
